annotations.title: Find a vault by what it has done

description: Find a vault by what it has DONE rather than what it is called. Free. The filter worth knowing is `earned`: `short` returns the vaults where a holder earned LESS than the venue advertises — how many there are is in the answer, never here — and `beating` the ones where they earned more. It matches only vaults whose realised return is COMPARABLE with an advertised one, which is a SMALL part of the open vaults and the exact share is in `vaults_earned`, not in this sentence; a venue that quotes nothing or a share price that never moves is excluded rather than counted as in-line, so a short list here means few comparable and not few that performed. Call vault_check on a slug for the full answer.

earned.description: in-line, beating or short — realised against advertised, comparable cases only.

maxRisk.description: Ceiling on the published risk score. Scored for a part of the open vaults and not all of them; the unscored are EXCLUDED from a scored filter, which is not the same as scoring well, and the counts are on the answer rather than here.

minOwnShare.description: Floor on the share of the vault its leader holds, 0 to 1. Readable on Hyperliquid and Drift only, so a floor on it excludes every other venue, where it is ABSENT and not zero. How many that is today is in the answer. Evidence of alignment, never proof: the holder can be a treasury or a custodian.

minTvl.description: Floor on stated size, in US dollars.

offset.description: Where to start, for the next page: send the `nextOffset` of the previous answer. Default 0.

platform.description: A platform id or its display name, e.g. morpho or Hyperliquid.

q.description: Part of a name or an address.
